verdict.rationale: LobeChat's privacy docs state chat data is stored locally by default and offers cloud sync (lobe-chat-docs-44), and there's a documented 'Migrate from Local Database' guide (lobe-chat-docs-30), implying some data portability path. However, there is no explicit documentation of a full data export feature, the open format(s) supported, or confirmation that all data (agents, settings, history) can be exported and reused elsewhere. Missing for 10: explicit export feature docs, named open format (JSON/Markdown/etc.), scope of exportable data, and independent/hands-on confirmation.
